messages:
alex: Heads-up: we need an image refresh for runner-base due to a glibc CVE (CVE-2026-0421). PoC exists; proposing staged rollout. @security-oncall
jane: On it. What's the blast radius? Is this exploitable in our runtime? :thinking:
mike: If glibc, likely affects any containers using the base. We should minimize changes: patch libc, rebuild, sign. Which pools use runner-base?
alex: Dedicated GPU pools + a subset of private on-prem customers. Timeline: want canary in ~24h, wider rollout in 48h if clean.
jane: For signing we need to scope the signer SA and ensure KMS usage is auditable. Proposed: create cosign-sign@infra.svc with only IAM role to CryptoKeyVersions/Use and no broad key admin perms.
mike: I can add an RBAC Role and ClusterRoleBinding for the cosign signer pod. Example (quick):
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: cosign-signer
  namespace: infra-build
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get"]
```
Then bind the service account to the pod.
lena: Also ensure cosign uses the KMS URI with explicit key version: "kms://gcp-kms/projects/.../locations/.../keyRings/.../cryptoKeys/.../cryptoKeyVersions/1" so the artifact metadata records which key version signed it.
karim: Will this break our canary routing which matches on image digest? We need to coordinate deploy config updates so we don't accidentally skip canaries.
alex: Good catch. Plan: canary will target digest prefix; will have fallback to previous tag for 6 hours. I'll open a tiny PR to update the deploy pipeline to accept digest prefix matching.
jane: Ops checklist for the rollout:
- create scoped signer SA with minimal IAM on KMS
- RBAC for cosign pod and secrets read
- enable key-use audit logs and forward to security logging pipeline
- rebuild base image, publish SBOM and attestation
- sign with KMS key version and attach attestation
- keep previous digest available for 24h rollback
- run vuln scan post-signing
- 2hr watch after canary, then 48h for full rollout
mike: I'll schedule staging window and reserve canary nodes. Who owns granting the signer SA write to the KMS key?
jane: security-svc-account-admin group holds key IAM. I'll open the request. @lena can you confirm the logging pipeline will show key usage within 15m? :eyes:
lena: Yep — logs will emit Cloud KMS IAM audit entries. Set log filter: resource.type="cloud_kms_key" protoPayload.methodName:"GenerateAccessToken" (or appropriate method). We'll also tag entries with deployment ID.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered by alex/1713777777 - staging build queued
alex: I'll attach PoC and full image inventory shortly. If anyone needs additional info about affected tags: ping me in-thread.
jane: After canary completes, require 2hr watch + automated vuln scan. If we see regressions or unexpected failures, rollback to previous digest and rotate the signer key (create new key version and re-sign stable images).
mike: Noted. I'll pause automatic pruning of old digests for 36h to allow rollback testing.
alex: Tagging policy: new patch tag v2026.03.21-patch created, keep latest pointing to stable after 24h of clean canary.
karim: I'll update runbooks and send an FYI to CS for customers on Dedicated / Private who might see short deploy windows.
jane: Requesting final ack from oncall: @security-oncall please ack and monitor during rollout.
security-oncall: Ack — oncall here. Will watch key IAM events and artifact attestation logs. If any suspicious key usage or signing failures show up, will open incident channel.
alex: Thanks all :thumbsup:
